obligations.description: - The evidence side is similarly underspecified. `Plans/evidence.schema.json` only gives a generic `checks[]` array with `name`, `result`, `details`, and optional `contract_refs`. That is too weak to carry structured route-aware verification outcomes without each check inventing its own ad hoc text.
